acceptedAnswer.text: Property, gold, vehicles, fixed deposits and certain securities.

mainEntity.name: Is Collateral Mandatory for Every Loan?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Only secured loans need it.

mainEntity.name: What Happens to Collateral if a Borrower Defaults?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your lender can enforce its security under the loan agreement and the applicable law, which may run as far as selling the asset. Notices reach you well before that point.

mainEntity.name: Can Property Be Used as Collateral for a Loan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, residential and commercial both. Check the documents required for loan against property first, because incomplete title papers are the usual reason these files stall.

mainEntity.name: Can Gold Be Used as Collateral?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, against a gold loan, subject to the lender's purity and valuation norms.

mainEntity.name: When Is Collateral Released After Loan Repayment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Within 30 days of full repayment, under RBI's rules.

mainEntity.name: Can I Get a Loan Without Collateral?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A personal loan needs no security at all.

mainEntity.name: What Factors Do Lenders Consider Besides Collateral?

acceptedAnswer.text: Income, employment stability, credit score, existing EMIs and your repayment record.

@graph.name: How a Secured Loan Uses Collateral, Step by Step

step.name: Pledge the asset
step.text: Hand the original ownership papers to your lender.

step.name: Valuation
step.text: Your lender has the asset valued, usually through an empanelled valuer.

step.name: Sanction and disbursal
step.text: A share of the assessed value is sanctioned and paid out, not the whole of it.

step.name: Release of charge
step.text: On full repayment the lender releases its charge and returns the original documents, within 30 days under RBI rules.
